======================== 𝐈𝐒𝐘𝐨𝐮_𝐌𝐨𝐯𝐢𝐞

MOVIE INFO
Bill Hader stars in the dark comedy series "Barry" as a hitman from the Midwest who is struggling with depression and dissatisfaction in life. He travels to Los Angeles to carry out a hit on an aspiring actor, but ends up getting entangled in the city's theatre arts scene. After following his target to an acting class, Barry discovers a sense of belonging among the group of hopeful actors. Despite his desire to start a new life in the acting world, his criminal past keeps pulling him back. Will Barry find a way to balance both worlds, or will he be forced to choose betwee them?
